newsitem.title: INDIA: India lower house approves 1996/97 central budget. [CORRECTED 13:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: India lower house approves 1996/97 central budget. [CORRECTED 13:45 GMT]

text.p: The lower house (Lok Sabha) in India's parliament has approved the 1996/97 (April-March) central budget on Monday (corrects day from Tuesday).
The lower house approved the bill which appropriates money to all ministries and departments for 1996/97, parliamentary officials said.
The measure did not include tax measures, which are included in the finance bill set to be taken up by parliament on Tuesday, they said.
Finance Minister P. Chidambaram was expected to address the lower house of parliament on Tuesday afternoon. Financial markets expected him to announce changes in a proposed minimum alternative tax.
The financial bill was expected to be put to a vote before the scheduled adjournment of parliament on Friday.
